about: A Rust library for reading and writing Excel spreadsheet files.

prs.title: "Between" rules in spreadsheets keep both limits
prs.broken: A data check like "a whole number between 1 and 10" lost both numbers when the file was saved, so the rule no longer checked anything.
prs.changed: Both limits are now written when the file is saved.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets keep their input checks after being opened and saved.

prs.title: Charts on sheets named like O'Brien no longer crash saving
prs.broken: Saving a workbook crashed when a chart sat on a sheet whose name had an apostrophe, such as O'Brien.
prs.changed: Sheet names with apostrophes are now read and written back correctly in chart references.
prs.matters: Workbooks with everyday names like O'Brien save without crashing.
